profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Office Depot
profile.summary:
•	21+ years of experience in System/Application Project Life Cycle Development 
•	Strong analytical and problem solving skills
•	Software Tools & Programming: Oracle, PL/SQL, DataStage, Microsoft SQL Server, DTS, Teradata, DB2, UNIX, Java, Java Scripts, Toad, SQL Developer, Eclipse, Salesforce, Snowflake, S3, AWS, Postgres, Agile, Microsoft Office Products.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: My responsibility includes leading/oversee team project(s), provide technical consultation, problem solving, project estimation, requirement analysis, design, coding, code review, testing, implementation, user support, on-call support, mentoring team members.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
- Led development team to integrate OD legacy data into Oracle Retek applications: Retek Demand Forecast (RDF), RDF-Europe, and Assortment Optimization.
- Developed over 30 interface processes to extract, transform and load Office Depot legacy data into Retek application, Merchandising Forecast Planning (MFP)
- Developed data modeling (Oracle) and backend processes for java front end applications, Vendor Program Forecast System and POG Submission (Planogram change request application)
- Provided solution implementation on various business needs on Space Planning, Planogram, and ICS (International Clearance Systems.

company.name: DMR Consulting Group Inc, an Amdahl company
